summary.content:
Today's selection covers 107 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 63 on Artificial Intelligence and 22 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Microsoft C.E.O. Satya Nadella Says ‘Everyone Is a Stakeholder’ in A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Chinese, N. Korean Threat Groups Build on Asia-Pacific Success
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, Dark Reading, BleepingComputer, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 46 articles published in the last 24 hours
